capabilities: Archive the active file or selected files and folders from the command palette, hotkey, toolbar, or context menu
Restore archived items to their original paths by running the same action
Route source folders to custom destinations with ordered routing rules
Configure conflict behavior when an archive target already exists
Automatically create intermediate folders without overwriting existing items
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes developer-facing localization and release instructions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to archive files and folders reversibly while keeping their original folder structure intact.
summary: File-archiving plugin that moves selected files and folders into a configurable archive root while preserving their original vault path, and restores them the same way.
